name: [FREE 🔫] Realistic Ragdoll Playground 💥
desc:
💥 REALISTIC RAGDOLL PLAYGROUND 💥

Every hit is real physics. Shoot, shove, blow up and run over dummies and watch them react: they stumble, grab their wounds, fall and get back up.

🎯 FEATURES
• Real active ragdoll physics, no canned animations
• 7 maps: Playground, Neighbourhood, Construction, Rooftops, Office, Mountain and Stunt Park
• Dummies live their own lives: mowing lawns, dancing, working and chatting
• They FIGHT BACK! Brawlers swing at you, gunmen draw on you, cowards run
• Red barrels explode and set off chain reactions
• Drive cars and send dummies flying
• Grab and throw dummies, then launch them off trampolines and ramps
• Earn badges for headshots, strikes, sky-high launches and more

🎮 Play on PC, mobile and console

⭐ Like and favourite if you enjoy it. More maps, weapons and updates coming soon!

llm.loop: spawn in a map -> shoot, blow up, throw and run over active-ragdoll dummies -> earn currency/badges -> unlock weapons
